Name: Drink Squid ink
Author: bananasalmon
Description:
[size=3][b]Introduction[/b][/size]
Do you also want to drink squid ink? Now you can! It is equally drinkable as for example oil and vinegar: 13 energy, 5 health and a feeling of embarassment, hoping that nobody noticed what you just did.

[size=3][b]Options and compatibility[/b][/size]
Can be installed anytime and will work immediately on the first in-game day!

To make it work on your stored squid ink, you will need to find a new fresh one and stack your old and stale undrinkable squid ink on top of your new drinkable squid ink. It's not a new item, just a property that does not change on existing items unless you stack! Stack the wrong way and your drinkable squid ink becomes undrinkable, and you will have to find a new one again.

No config options are added. To uninstall, just delete the mod. Newly found squid ink will not be drinkable and you can stack the drinkable squid ink on top of the undrinkable squid ink.

Should be compatible with mods that change other properties of squid ink such as its price or item category. For example, from what it says in the description, Vegas' mod, which sometimes changes multiple item properties, should be compatible too, but has not been tested.

[size=3][b]Roadmap[/b][/size]
I think this mod is perfect as is. But, if you want to explore the world of squid ink even more, I am open to suggestions.

[size=3][b]Credits[/b][/size]
Nothing, idea by me.
